cohort: 2,397 patients who underwent elective surgical procedures (cesarean, inguinal herniorrhaphy, breast cancer surgery, cholecystectomy, saphenectomy, sternotomy, thoracotomy, or knee arthroscopy)
finding: The cumulative risk of N-PSPP within 6 months after surgery ranged from 3.2% (laparoscopic herniorrhaphy) to 37.1% (breast cancer surgery) and was associated with older age, low anxiety score, recent negative life events, low preoperative quality of life, and previous history of peripheral neuropathy.
